reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-09-29. Reservoir documents wsrUSD as a yield-bearing token minted and redeemed through rUSD. Blockscout's fully verified Savingcoin source shows the constructor (name "Wrapped Savings rUSD", symbol "wsrUSD", admin 0xb7570e32dED63B25163369D5eb4D8e89E70e5602) setting the ERC-4626 asset to rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, with deposit burning rUSD and withdrawal minting rUSD. At Ethereum block 26083700 (2026-09-29T14:23:59Z), public RPC eth_call reads on 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094 returned asset() = rUSD, totalAssets() = 107,793,940.517 rUSD, totalSupply() = 97,966,642.087 wsrUSD (NAV about 1.1003), and rUSD.balanceOf(wrapper) = 0. The zero idle rUSD balance follows from the verified burn/mint accounting and is not evidence of a different direct reserve. The same-day Reservoir raw balance sheet independently lists the wsrUSD liability at $107,793,474.46 of $108,533,701.55 total liabilities (rUSD $119,482.40, srUSD $620,744.69), matching the wrapper's own totalAssets() within same-day timing noise; assets under wrap grew from 59.19M rUSD at the 2026-08-29 review. The direct composition is therefore a single 100% wrapper claim on the tracked parent rusd-reservoir, mirroring srUSD's claim on the same parent; the underlying reserve basket, strategy allocation, and custody remain upstream facts tracked on the rusd-reservoir record (last refreshed 2026-09-21).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Verified Savingcoin ERC-4626 source/constructor and pinned Ethereum eth_call reads at block 26083700 (2026-09-29T14:23:59Z), corroborated by the same-day Reservoir raw balance sheet
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct underlying is fully identified as rUSD. The wrapper intentionally burns rUSD on deposit and mints it on withdrawal, so its idle rUSD balance is zero; reserve-basket and custody details remain upstream facts tracked on rusd-reservoir.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: wsrUSD's only direct reserve is rUSD deposited in the non-upgradeable ERC-4626 wrapper contract (asset() = rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, re-verified 2026-07-20), so custody of the economic backing is inherited entirely from rUSD: the upstream Reservoir balance sheet sits in protocol-controlled adapter contracts with no named third-party custodian, trust, SPV, or holder claim documented in the ToS (2024-08-23) or product docs. The wrapper itself does not re-lend its rUSD, but the upstream rUSD reserve model is active re-deployment into lending markets, vaults, and RWA credit, so rehypothecation is marked permitted at the economic level. Redemption is documented as immediate only up to available PSM liquidity. Wrapper parameters (setCap, update) are governed by the 3-of-5 MANAGER Safe 0x4E8a4894275780f571AaD53122e641D9f50Ff04f, while DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE remains with EOA 0xb7570e32 and can grant or revoke MANAGER (mint-authority review, 2026-07-14). No bankruptcy-remoteness structure for wsrUSD holders is documented.
